summary.en: Agasa takes the Detective Boys to watch a parade. They run into Sato who explains that they received a bomb threat and believe it is related to a bomb case three years ago. Takagi's disguise causes Sato to experience traumatic flashbacks and she resultantly slaps Takagi. The other officers reveal Takagi's disguise resembles Sato's dead partner, Matsuda. During the parade, the bomber detonates an explosive hidden under Takagi's Gray GT-R; Takagi luckily was able to avoid the explosion. When Takagi leans down to pick up his car keys, he sees a mysterious paper bag and decides to run away ask Shiratori if the bag contains anything suspicious, ultimately saving him from a certain death, as his car explodes just as he leaves.
